title: Widget Loading and Data Calculation Accuracy
steps: Verify Total Runs widget equals response length (4)
Verify Average Duration matches mathematical average of durationSec
expectedBehavior: All 4 widgets render correctly formatted metrics without rounding errors

title: Status Dropdown Filtering
expectedBehavior: Instant client-side filter update without DOM reflow jitter

title: Multi-Column Text Search
steps: Assert only author-matching rows are visible
expectedBehavior: Filters records matching ID, name, or author case-insensitively

title: Column Header Sorting (Numeric & String)
expectedBehavior: Table reorders dynamically without page reloads

title: Admin Role Mutation Controls Visibility
expectedBehavior: + New Test Run CTA is visible; Delete action buttons exist in every row

title: Viewer Role Mutation Controls Masking
expectedBehavior: Mutating UI actions are strictly stripped from DOM for read-only users

title: Mobile Responsive Viewport and Navigation Drawer
steps: Assert sidebar is not visible in viewport
Assert hamburger toggle button is visible
Assert sidebar class contains 'open' and is positioned on screen
expectedBehavior: Layout smoothly transforms from desktop layout to mobile drawer
